update.name: GameScreen.tsx — Revised Screen-Fit Layout with Ad Slots
update.context: GameScreen.tsx needs a full revision to implement the locked zone layout. 100dvh, no scroll, portrait-mobile-first. Zones (top to bottom): TopBar 44px | EnergyBar 48px | InfoStrip 36px | Grid flex-1 | BankBar 68px HeistGameScreen adds VaultBar 56px below BankBar. Permanently removed: page title, inline ThemeToggle, sidebar HUD, standalone BankButton. Ad slots: interstitial shown between rounds (ROUND_END state), rewarded ad in BankBar. Grid cell sizing via ResizeObserver: cellSize = floor((min(w,h) - padding) / gridDim). Min cell: 28px. Max cell: 72px. Gap: 2px. Visual direction: actual 3D modern.

dependencies.dep: update-40 — useGame with round flow exists

constraints.constraint: 100dvh height. overflow: hidden on root. No page scroll ever.
Gear is U+2699 text character only.
No page title "FARKLE FRENZY" — TopBar shows mode label only.
No standalone BankButton component — bank action is inside BankBar.
No inline ThemeToggle — it is in SettingsModal.
Ad slots are optional props — game works without them.

do-not.rule: Do not add page title or header text "FARKLE FRENZY".
Do not add sidebar or left column HUD.
Do not add standalone BankButton component import.
Do not use setInterval for ResizeObserver polling — use the API directly.
Do not make ad slots required — they are optional props with defaults of undefined.

verification.check: Total fixed zone height is 196px (44+48+36+68) leaving flex-1 for grid
No scroll appears on mobile portrait at 375px width
ResizeObserver fires and cellSize updates on window resize
